The root cause is a hardware address space change. When the customer replaced the OPC controller hardware over the weekend (Slack), the underlying memory or network address space shifted. Tag bindings in the system are hardcoded to specific addresses from the old hardware configuration. The new controller uses a different address space, rendering all existing bindings invalid and causing read failures (ticket description).

**Supporting evidence:** The Slack message explicitly states "Address space changed under them" following the Saturday hardware swap. This directly explains why all tag bindings now resolve to invalid addresses.

**Information gap:** I could not access customer account data (Snowflake returned no results) or customer emails (Gmail returned no results), so I cannot confirm whether the customer has documentation of the old address mappings or whether this is a known configuration issue with this hardware model. The Confluence result appears irrelevant—meeting notes about Python and AI concepts do not address this ticket. 

**Next steps needed:** Obtain the address mapping from the old controller and the new controller's address space configuration to rebuild the tag bindings. Confirm whether the system has any automatic remapping capability or if manual rebinding is required.
